answers.usable_structures_detail: 1155 XYZ on disk == 1155 rows in accepted_geometries.csv == 1155 rows in geometry_feature_status.csv == 1155 graphs in vietoris_rips_inputs.npz == 1155 rows in complex_physical_scalars.parquet and coordination_polyhedron.parquet; all 1155 carry qc_status=accepted and qc_class=OK; 0 checksum mismatches; 0 parse errors; 1116 of the 1155 additionally carry xTB properties and a persistence image (39 do not).
answers.ligand_only_or_complex: Ln-complex (exactly one Ln per file, 14 lanthanides, all Ln(III))
answers.conformers_per_ligand_metal: 1.12 mean, max 2, over 1031 (ligand, metal) cells: 907 cells have 1 file, 124 have 2. The 2-file cells are NOT conformer replicas - all 124 differ in inner_sphere_anion (nitrate vs water). Every (geometry_key) and every full chemical environment (smiles, metal, anion, fill, coreCN, n_ligs, ox) maps to exactly one file. There is NO conformational ensemble anywhere in this bundle.
answers.charge_consistency: metal_ox = +3 in 1155/1155 spec rows. The extxyz initial_charges column puts the whole net complex charge on the metal atom: net +3 in 901 files, +2 in 181, +1 in 63, unknown in 10 (no charge column). NO neutral complex exists. Net charge = 3 - (number of coordinated nitrate groups) in 1140/1145 files with a charge column; 5 outliers; 4 files spread the charge over non-metal atoms instead of the metal.
answers.metals: 14 lanthanides (La Ce Pr Nd Sm Eu Gd Tb Dy Ho Er Tm Yb Lu; Z = 57-60, 62-71). Pm (Z=61) absent, and Y/Sc/actinides absent.
answers.coordination_numbers: declared coreCN is 8 (503 files) or 9 (652 files) only; mean 8.565. Donor element mix across the 9834 declared donor slots: O 8279, N 1554, S 58, P 1. The declared CN is a build spec, not a measurement: only 896/1155 (77.6%) have exactly coreCN atoms within 3.10 A of the metal; 259 have more (up to +4).
answers.failure_exclusion_rate: 101 of 1256 baseline geometry specs excluded = 8.04% of complexes; 513 of 5992 rows = 8.56% of rows. 78 qc_rejected (40 BORDERLINE_AMBIGUOUS_SHELL, 26 FAIL_LONG_BOND, 12 BORDERLINE_LONGISH), 15 generation_failed, 8 terminal_generation_failure. 0 geometry-feature failures downstream.
answers.duplicates: none. 0 duplicate file SHA-256, 0 duplicate coordinate sets, 0 duplicate build_id, 1155 unique geometry_key, 1155 unique final_xyz_name, and 0 ligand frames (heavy atoms with the metal removed) shared between any two files.
answers.canonical_smiles_with_geometry: 177 of 190 (93.2%); 13 ligands have zero geometry, accounting for 81 rows. 141 of 190 ligands are fully covered, 36 partially.
answers.rows_mapped_to_a_geometry: 5479 of 5992 (91.44%); 513 rows have no geometry. Identical numbers in row_geometry_map.csv, dataset.parquet geometry_ok, and dataset_geometry_available.parquet (5479 rows).
